situational_context: Running comeback at 147 days (37 runs since May 3, 2026). C4 block #21-40 expired — archived today (12 km Beaumonts objective not attempted; ~20 of 40 prescribed sessions completed due to persistent under-execution). Return to gravel riding after 122 days: 22.5 km on Sep 15 (load 36) then 49.6 km on Sep 21 (load 145, suffer 145, HR avg 142.1) — this single ride spiked ACWR to 2.45, far above the 1.50 comeback cap, pushing Garmin status to 'Overreaching'. Recovery markers bottomed Sep 22 (RHR 59, HRV 24, body battery 16.5, readiness 1) and have substantially recovered by Sep 27 (RHR 54, body battery 55.5, readiness 64). The Sep 26 easy run (5.02 km, HR 130, suffer 13) was well-tolerated — lower HR at the same distance vs prior weeks confirms no residual cardiac strain. VO2max running improved to 42.7 (from 42.2). Weight 100.84 kg with favorable composition shift (muscle +1.6 kg, fat −0.52 kg vs Sep 15). MEDICATION: Benjamin is on Wegovy (semaglutide, GLP-1 receptor agonist) 0.25 mg weekly since Aug 12 (day 46 of therapy). Dose escalation to 0.5 mg CONFIRMED for Sep 30 (decided at Sep 15 consultation with Dr Monnier). Last injection Sep 23 (Wednesday). RHR +5.7 bpm vs pre-treatment baseline (49.3) — at upper edge of expected class effect, partly driven by gravel ACWR spike; HRV 30 (LOW, unchanged for 4+ weeks, expected class effect); no second recovery signal consistently off. Nutrition not logged for 35 consecutive days (since Aug 23) — on Wegovy this is a critical fuelling concern: protein floor, energy availability and hydration are unverifiable. No new labs since Dec 2025; Vitamin D retest now 3+ months overdue.

medications.name: Wegovy (semaglutide)
medications.dose: 0.25 mg weekly (starter step — last at this dose, escalation confirmed)
medications.interpretation_notes: RHR +1-5 bpm and lower HRV expected (class effect) - use post-initiation baseline and require a second signal before flagging. Appetite suppressed - protein >= 1.6 g/kg daily, zero-intake days may be real under-eating. Weight loss expected at therapeutic doses (0.5 mg+). Delayed gastric emptying - last solid meal >= 3h pre-run. Post-injection side-effect window Thu-Sat. Dose escalation Sep 30 opens a 14-day watch window: expect stronger GI effects, possible further RHR offset, restart rebaseline clock.

recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. 35 consecutive days without logged intake while on a GLP-1 appetite suppressant is the most critical data gap: protein floor (1.6 g/kg = 161 g/day), energy availability and hydration status are all unverifiable. On Wegovy, reduced appetite means intake may genuinely be too low (under-fueling risk), not just unlogged. The dose escalation to 0.5 mg on Sep 30 will likely suppress appetite further — logging becomes even more important to distinguish real under-eating from a logging gap. Aim for protein-dense, low-volume, low-fat foods given delayed gastric emptying.
recommendations.measurable: Logged intake on >= 5 of next 7 days; protein >= 1.6 g/kg (161 g) on logged days

recommendations.text: Dose escalation to 0.5 mg Wegovy on Sep 30: expect stronger GI effects (nausea, early satiety, possible diarrhoea) in the first 1-2 weeks, a possible further RHR offset of +1-2 bpm, and more pronounced appetite suppression. The RHR/HRV rebaseline clock restarts — the post-0.25 mg baseline (RHR ~54, HRV ~30) is no longer the reference after Sep 30. Hydrate aggressively (>= 3.5 L/day). Pre-run meal gap stays >= 3h. No hard sessions in the first 14 days (Oct 1-14). Log any GI symptoms in the symptoms tracker to build a dose-response profile.
recommendations.measurable: GI symptoms logged if present; hydration >= 3.5 L/day on 5+ of 14 days; no session skipped silently due to GI — log as 'moved — GI side effect'
